description: This file defines the ContentTypes class responsible for generating the XML 'ContentTypes' part of an XLSX package in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages writing various content type overrides and defaults for different parts of an Excel file, such as worksheets, charts, media, and core properties.

classes.name: ContentTypes
classes.description: Handles the creation of the XML content types file for XLSX, defining how different parts of the spreadsheet are identified and managed within the package.

methods.name: writeContentTypes
methods.description: Generates the full XML content types document for the spreadsheet package, including defaults and overrides for worksheets, charts, media, and other components.

methods.name: getImageMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of an image file based on its filename by inspecting its size and type.

methods.name: writeDefaultContentType
methods.description: Writes a '<Default>' element specifying the default content type for a given file extension.

methods.name: writeOverrideContentType
methods.description: Writes an '<Override>' element for a specific part of the package with its content type.
